rongmei.title: Kagan hei na guang pu the.

lines: 1. Kagan hei naguang puthe jianmei nun ta tam khang,
Kandih arup jianmei thiu le;
Jianmei nun ata mu ri o,
Tingsang ramgai guangtang pukhou.
Chorus:
Jianmeinun neilana tatro, ntam dikho salam;
Nang rih hu khou mai le muang rui,
Guang Immanuel rui jailou diu.
2. Kandih rianramei rui jing rianra pui kandih hei,
Njianmei nun ntam pui bam;
Tingsang ramgai guangtang pukhou,
Hei kandih hei ning dat lak khe.
3. Kandih rianra duidai khou mikdui luangmei ruina,
Achang hou maknga bam khou hei;
Mikdui thut phuina dinlou o,
Tingsang ring nimei chang khou 4@&.
4. Jianmei nun ta tam khou rui mikdui luangmei ruina,
Dui kumma dailou ngam kan the;
Kandih jingmei rana dithe,
Neilamei khuan chu dat mak khe.
5. Poubaumei ta lum ethei ntam kanmei guai le,
Guang Jisu le bam cham puni;
Khou 4@& mikdui thut phui lou ni,
Rianramei mak pui bam khou 4@&.
6. Pou jan khou ntam louna mikdui luanglou kanmei,
Guai rui kanloumei la puni;
Khou 4@& rianra kapmei mikdui,
Guang Jisu rui thut phui lou ni.
